summary_en: This study tests amivantamab alone or with other drugs (pembrolizumab, paclitaxel, or pembrolizumab with carboplatin) in squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck, including recurrent or metastatic disease and resectable locally advanced disease before and after surgery. Amivantamab is given as a subcutaneous injection weekly in Cycle 1 and then every 3 weeks, and pembrolizumab, paclitaxel and carboplatin are given intravenously, with carboplatin for Cycles 1 to 6 in one arm; total treatment length is not stated. The study measures safety and early signs of effectiveness and confirms a recommended dose with paclitaxel, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa amivantamab solo o combinado con otros medicamentos (pembrolizumab, paclitaxel o pembrolizumab con carboplatino) en el carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello, incluida la enfermedad recurrente o metastásica y la enfermedad localmente avanzada resecable antes y después de la cirugía. Amivantamab se administra como inyección subcutánea semanalmente en el Ciclo 1 y luego cada 3 semanas, mientras que pembrolizumab, paclitaxel y carboplatino se administran por vena cada 3 semanas, y el carboplatino en los Ciclos 1 a 6 en un brazo; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad y las primeras señales de efectividad y confirma una dosis recomendada con paclitaxel, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma considered incurable by local therapies
For the perioperative cohort: resectable locally advanced disease, stage III or IVa
Primary tumor in the oropharynx, oral cavity, hypopharynx, or larynx, with cohort-specific tumor marker rules
Adequate blood counts and organ function (hemoglobin, neutrophils, platelets)
not_for: Interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis, or suspected disease not ruled out by imaging
Untreated brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression not definitively treated
Recent chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy or investigational agent within 2 weeks or 4 half-lives, whichever is longer (maximum 28 days)
Palliative radiotherapy within 7 days of the first study dose
cancer_types: squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck
